title: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding
authors: Yaniv Leviathan, Matan Kalman, Yossi Matias
abstract: Inference from large autoregressive models like Transformers is slow - decoding K tokens takes K serial runs of the model. In this work we introduce speculative decoding - an algorithm to sample from autoregressive models faster without any changes to the outputs, by computing several tokens in parallel. […] We demonstrate it on T5-XXL and show a 2X-3X acceleration compared to the standard T5X implementation, with identical outputs.
rec: 主题订阅回填的奠基文:你库里三条 spec-dec 结论都建在它的接受准则上,值得留档原文。

title: LongSpec: Long-Context Lossless Speculative Decoding
abstract: Speculative decoding reduces LLM decoding latency by verifying multiple drafted tokens in parallel, but tree-structured drafting is believed to stop paying off beyond a modest width. We revisit this knee-point result in batched long-context serving and show that with shared prefixes, verification cost is amortized across the batch; wider trees remain net-positive well beyond prior reports, yielding up to 2.4× end-to-end speedup.

title: Sequoia-2: Hardware-Aware Adaptive Tree Construction for Speculative Decoding
abstract: We present Sequoia-2, which constructs speculative decoding trees adaptively per request using a hardware-aware cost model. Tree topology is optimized online against measured verification throughput rather than a fixed budget, improving accepted tokens per second by 18–31% across A100 and H200 serving configurations.

title: DrafterLite: Distilling Draft Models that Know When to Stop
abstract: Draft models waste compute by proposing tokens past their competence. DrafterLite distills a stopping head jointly with the draft model, letting it terminate speculation early on hard spans. This recovers most of the speedup of larger drafters at 40% of the draft cost.

title: FlashAttention-3: Fast and Accurate Attention with Asynchrony and Low-precision
authors: Jay Shah, Ganesh Bikshandi, Ying Zhang, Vijay Thakkar, Pradeep Ramani, Tri Dao
abstract: (要点转写)FlashAttention-2 在 H100 上只用到约 35% 算力。这篇提出三项 Hopper 专属技术:warp-specialization 让计算与搬运异步重叠、分块 matmul 与 softmax 交错执行、FP8 分块量化加 incoherent processing。结果:FP16 达 740 TFLOPs/s(约 75% 利用率),FP8 接近 1.2 PFLOPs/s,整体 1.5–2.0×,且 FP8 数值误差比基线低 2.6×。
rec: 你关注的作者新作:attention 层的算力天花板又抬高一截,与 spec-dec 的验证 kernel 正交、可叠加。

title: ThunderKV: Fused Attention Kernels for Long-Context Serving
abstract: We introduce ThunderKV, a family of fused attention kernels that co-schedule KV-cache reads with speculative verification. On shared-prefix workloads ThunderKV reduces memory stalls by 2.1× and composes with existing tree-drafting schedulers without modification.
